mappings.note: Content matches perfectly: Satan inciting David to count Israel.
Content matches perfectly: David's command to Joab from Be'er-Sjeba to Dan.
The translation text is truncated in the input ('...hundred times other tantos. Rey señor mío, ¿no son todos estos siervos de mi señor'), but corresponds to the start of OSMAIN v3.
Content matches perfectly: King's order stands, Joab travels and returns.
Content matches perfectly: The census numbers (1.1M Israel, 470k Judah).
Content matches perfectly: Levi and Benjamin excluded because the order was abominable to Joab.
Content matches perfectly: Evil in God's eyes, He strikes Israel.
Content matches perfectly: David confesses sin and asks for forgiveness.
Content matches perfectly: Lord speaks to Gad.
Content matches perfectly: God offers three choices through Gad.
Content matches perfectly: Gad arrives and repeats the message.
The translation text is truncated in the input ('...three years of hunger; or three months destroyed before your enemies...'), but corresponds to OSMAIN v12.
Content matches perfectly: David chooses God's hand over man's.
Content matches perfectly: Pestilence sent, 70,000 fall.
The translation text is truncated in the input ('...destroying, looked and repented of that evil, said to the destroying angel: Enough; stay your hand'), but corresponds to OSMAIN v15.
The translation text is truncated in the input ('...David lifted eyes and saw angel between heaven and earth with sword drawn...'), but corresponds to OSMAIN v16.
The translation text is truncated in the input ('...David said to God: Was it not I who ordered? ... let your hand fall on me and my father's house'), but corresponds to OSMAIN v17.
Content matches perfectly: Angel tells Gad to tell David to build an altar at Ornan's threshing floor.
Content matches perfectly: David goes up according to Gad's word.
Content matches perfectly: Ornan sees angel, sons hide, Ornan threshing wheat.
Content matches perfectly: David arrives, Ornan sees him and bows down.
Content matches perfectly: David asks to buy the threshing floor for full price to stop the plague.
Content matches perfectly: Ornan offers everything (oxen, sledges, wheat) for free.
Content matches perfectly: David refuses free gift, insists on full price.
Content matches perfectly: David pays 600 shekels of gold.
Content matches perfectly: Altar built, offerings made, fire from heaven.
Content matches perfectly: Lord speaks to angel, sword returned to sheath.
Content matches perfectly: David sees God answered him at Ornan's floor and sacrifices there.
Content matches perfectly: Explanation of the Tabernacle in Gibeon at that time.
Content matches perfectly: David could not go to Gibeon due to fear of the angel's sword.

This verse in the translation (v31) repeats the content of OSMAIN v30. The translation splits the final thought into two verses (29/30 in OSMAIN vs 30/31 in Translation), or rather, the translation has an extra verse number for the same content found in OSMAIN v30.

extraContent.description: The text of this verse ('Mas David no pudo ir allá á consultar á Dios...') is identical to the content of OSMAIN verse 30. The translation appears to have split the final narrative block or added an extra verse number for the same event described in OSMAIN v30.
